title: Elderly Mother Beside Blooming Bush, 1950s Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
2478

I like this one. Isn't that
bush pretty in back of mama?
It was loaded with blooms.
description: A classic mid-century snapshot with deckled edges depicting an elderly mother standing proudly on a grass lawn next to a large shrub laden with blossoming flowers. She wears a simple button-front house dress and rests her hands in front of her waist. A utility gas meter is visible to the left near a road or driveway.
